hypothesis: A grounded character prompt plus evidence-backed flexible goals will reduce coaching while a visible ordered plan and public situation brief keep the task understandable.
scope: out-of-order goal evidence in text and voice
compatibility: New live sessions use flexible progress; old sessions keep their saved progress mode and history. No automatic overwrite of authored scenarios.
checks: no private facts in public brief
stop: Implementation, tests, browser checks and bounded text probes complete; live microphone/video separately labelled
